title: Recall: Iterate ranges and return a loop result
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

skip.clue: Inside a for loop binding value: i32, write an if statement using remainder and equality to skip even values with continue.

exit.clue: Inside a loop expression with mutable n: i32, write an if statement that exits with n * 2 when n equals 4. Use break with a value.
